title: Concept: Gradle build resolves from a snapshot repository
description: build.gradle declares a repository whose URL is the snapshot channel, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Snapshots are rebuilt in place, so the same build file can compile different code on two runs.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: Snapshots are rebuilt in place, so the same build file can compile different code on two runs.
